August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 131)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American and British networks, Willard Waterman as The Great Gildersleeve attempting self-sufficiency for Kraft, Milton Berle saluting American railroads for Eversharp, Kay Kyser's daytime audition for Pillsbury and Ivory Soap, Wheaties' Curtain Time, Humphrey Lyttelton and Barry Cryer satirizing the Common Market on I'm Sorry I Haven't a Clue, and Mark Twain's The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn dramatized for schools on NBC Blue (1938–1975):
